cvEn:
Lazar (Riki) Lustig, son of Sara and Moshe, was born on the 16th of Elul 5705 (25 August 1945) in Bucharest, the capital of Romania. He studied at a music school there and played the violin. When he came to Israel, he entered tenth grade at a high school in Eilat. He studied at the Air Force technical school in Haifa, and afterward was drafted into the IDF in April 1963 and served in the Air Force. He loved building airplanes and worked in electrical systems on aircraft. During his military service he studied in evening classes and was a member of the aero club.

On the 14th of Adar II 5725 (18 March 1965), he fell while carrying out his duties, and he was laid to rest in the cemetery in Eilat.
